5.1 –Opening Question
¨Examine the tortoises found in the image to the left. ¨With a partner, discuss the appearance of the tortoises, and identify and which might belong to the same or different species.
explanation: This page introduces Section 5.1 with an opening group discussion question. It instructs students to examine an image of tortoises, discuss their physical appearance with a partner, and attempt to determine which tortoises belong to the same species and which belong to different species, introducing the concepts of morphological differences and species diversity.

questions.q: What organism is used in the opening question to introduce morphological comparison and species identification?
questions.exp: The opening question asks students to examine and discuss the appearance of tortoises to identify species differences.
